tools.name: search_ai_services
tools.description: Search AI services listed on AIFinder, a Korean AI-tool directory whose Korean-language support, KRW pricing, Korean business registration and free-trial conditions are verified on each official site. Accepts natural-language Korean or English queries and filters. Returns up to 10 services per call

tools.name: get_ai_service
tools.description:
Get details of one AI service: Korean description, verified Korean support and trial conditions with plain-language evidence, pricing, platforms, login methods and links. Pass the `key` from search results or the service's official URL.
서비스 하나의 상세 정보(국문 설명, 한국어·체험 실측 근거, 가격, 링크)를 돌려줍니다.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description:
Find alternatives to an AI service within the same category, ranked by a public rule-based score (not ads or user ratings). Up to 5 results.
같은 분야의 대안 서비스를 찾습니다(규칙 기반, 광고·평점 미반영).

tools.name: compare_category
tools.description:
Compare the top AI services in one secondary category on Korean UI, KRW pricing, starting price and trial conditions. Up to 10 services.
2차 분류 하나의 상위 서비스를 한국어·원화·시작가·체험 조건으로 비교합니다.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
List AIFinder categories (slug, Korean name, number of listed services). Use the slugs for the `category` argument of other tools.
분류 slug·한국어 이름·서비스 수 목록입니다. 다른 도구의 category 값으로 씁니다.
